key_insight: SynDebug is a systems-level debugging framework that brings lightweight assertion-based checks directly into fault-tolerant quantum computing programs without materially increasing logical error risk.
engineering_relevance: It offers a practical way to debug realistic encoded FTQC workflows, helping engineers validate complex quantum software beyond idealized logical circuits.
method: Adds assertion-based debugging primitives inside encoded FTQC execution flows
Avoids extra logical surface area while keeping temporal overhead low
Supports multiple QEC code families, code distances, and workloads
evidence_signal: Across state preparation, entanglement validation, and Shor-style programs, SynDebug averaged 1.8% additional circuit depth overhead, was 0% in most cases, and showed no measurable increase in logical error rate.
watch_item: The framework is lightweight, but real deployment still depends on careful integration with specific QEC stacks and workload-specific assertion placement.
paper_title: SynDebug: A Framework to Debug Logic Bugs in Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computing Programs
